messages:
Maya Chen: quick async standup from CS — handing back BridgeFix renewal escalation. What I did / Blockers / Today:

Maya Chen: What I did: ran webhook replay against prod-sandbox and reran embedding requests for the integration tests. Confirmed intermittent 502s and elevated latency on /v1/embeddings for a small subset of requests.

Maya Chen: Blockers: still seeing 502s (~0.5% of requests). I created ticket BF-142 with logs and a postmortem sketch. Need eng to confirm whether the circuit-breaker/routing fallback triggered or if we hit memory pressure on the host.

Maya Chen: Today: collect a cleaned log bundle for partner, try to reproduce in staging, and prep a short customer-facing note. @Alan Park can you pick up the routing/circuit-breaker check? cc @Olivia Ruiz

Alan Park: Got it — will grab BF-142 after lunch. Can you paste a failing request id and a minimal header so I can grep traces?

Maya Chen: failing ids: `bf-req-2026-03-16-0420`, `bf-req-2026-03-16-0501`. sample header attached:
```json
{"x-request-id":"bf-req-2026-03-16-0420","path":"/v1/embeddings","model":"open-embed-v2","region":"us-west-2"}
```

Olivia Ruiz: FYI — had a renewal call yesterday. BridgeFix expects a short assurance note before 4/02 renewal. They reported higher latency spikes and want to know if there's a known mitigation (routing to Dedicated or temporary QAT). If we need a canary failover, we should tell them ETA.

cs-bot: Incident created BF-2026-03-16-1 — https://redwood.internal/incidents/BF-2026-03-16-1 (priority: P2), linked ticket BF-142.

Alan Park: Thanks. First pass: I'll check routing policy logs and host memory trends, then verify whether our fallback to the quantized variant kicked in. If it's memory related we can try a temporary routing policy change to a dedicated pool for them. Will post traces here.

Alan Park: Quick note — possible mitigation: route heavy embedding requests to the `dedicated-embed-8g` pool or enable `prefer-quantized=true` for their route to avoid KV cache pressure. Need an ops window to flip.

Maya Chen: That sounds good. Blocker for me: need an eng confirmation about how long the routing change would take and if we can do a one-day trial waiver for Dedicated routing. I need a 2-3 sentence blurb to send to the customer.

Rami Desai: Pricing/ops side — short trial for one day is OK from billing; I'll draft an email offering a complimentary dedicated day and include technical caveats. Can someone add a 1-2 line explanation of the routing change I can paste?

Alan Park: Draft blurb: "We will route your embedding traffic to a dedicated embedding instance for 24 hours and enable a quantized execution path to reduce memory pressure. This typically eliminates intermittent 502s while we collect traces; no code change required on your side." Fine to share.

Olivia Ruiz: Perfect — I'll send that after Rami's email is ready. Maya — I'll join the staging repro later if you want a hand. :thumbsup:

Maya Chen: Appreciated. I'll drop the cleaned logs and the customer-friendly note here by EOD. If Alan posts traces, I'll attach them to BF-142 and to the incident.

Alan Park: Added initial trace snippet to BF-142 and a quick check command:
```bash
# check recent routing decisions for route: /v1/embeddings
redwoodctl routes logs --route /v1/embeddings --since 2h --filter "status=502"
```

Maya Chen: Thanks everyone — will follow up once I have the bundle.

Olivia Ruiz: thumbs up :thumbsup:

cs-bot: Reminder scheduled — update BridgeFix customers by 2026-03-17 15:00 UTC.
